Google Maps sur Android Auto affiche enfin votre vitesse (avec deux ans de retard sur CarPlay)

📅 2026-07-24 ✍️ Nadim Lefebvre, iGeneration 🏷️ Google Maps, Android Auto, speedometer, CarPlay, navigation, GPS precision
🔗 Read the source article →

💡 Quick summary

Google Maps on Android Auto is finally rolling out a real-time speedometer display, catching up to Apple CarPlay which has had the feature since 2024 — and highlighting the often superior precision of GPS-derived speed over mechanical speedometers.

📌 Key takeaways

  • Google Maps on Android Auto is deploying a real-time speedometer alongside speed limit displays
  • The indicator turns yellow then red when exceeding the posted speed limit
  • Apple CarPlay has had this feature natively since 2024, and Google Maps mobile apps since 2019
  • Waze, owned by Google since 2013, has had a similar indicator since its inception
  • GPS-calculated speed is often more accurate than mechanical speedometers, which manufacturers deliberately calibrate to overestimate
